# Third-party slash textures (CC0)

All files in this directory are **CC0 / public domain**. No attribution is
required; credit is kept here for provenance.

| File | Source | Author | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oga-slash-blue.png` | [Slash effect](https://opengameart.org/content/slash-effect) (`Slash symmetrical blue.png`) | MetaShinryu | CC0 |
| `oga-slash-gray.png` | [Slash effect](https://opengameart.org/content/slash-effect) (`Slash desaturated.png`) | MetaShinryu | CC0 |
| `fgs-slash-trail.png` | [Slash Attack Trail](https://freegamesprites.com/en/assets/slash-attack-trail) | FreeGameSprites | CC0 |
| `fgs-sword-slash.png` | [Sword Slash Effect](https://freegamesprites.com/en/assets/sword-slash-effect) | FreeGameSprites | CC0 |
| `*-ribbon.png` | Local bake of the rows above via `tools/bake_vendor_ribbons.py` | — | CC0 (derived) |

Original crescents are kept for provenance. Runtime styles load the `*-ribbon.png`
strips so UV.y maps root→tip on the fan mesh. Do not replace with non-CC0 game rips.
